name: Erce

attributes.attribute: known from early British verbal charms

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Erce was a British goddess and an obscure figure. She was called the mother of earth. Bards knew her from early British verbal formulae, the charms of that land. Her identity survives in these formulaic words. Little else about her cult has come down to us.

okr.objective: Write a faithful but concise rewrite of the thin Erce entry.
key_results: State that Erce was a British mother of earth goddess
